## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Each adopted setting now prints twice when the command runs, so you should fix the duplicate "Adopted <name>" output before merge.

## Changes
`plan` now returns an `adopt` entry for every setting that already exists, and it appends a final `audit` entry that counts the incoming settings. The pull request adds two tests for the audit entry and a new `app/review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop the command printing "Adopted <name>" twice — When `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` is called, `emit` receives "Adopted theme" twice. The first comes from the progress `emit` at `app/planner.py:8`. The second happens because `app/cli.py:6-9` emits the message of every change that is not an `audit` entry, and this pull request adds the `adopt` entry to that list. — Every command run that adopts existing settings shows duplicate lines, and no test covers `run` with an existing setting. — Fix: Skip `adopt` entries alongside `audit` at `app/cli.py:7`, and add a `run` test with an existing setting next to `test_adoption_progress`.
